result.description:
Location: 		Port Broughton, SA, 5522
Full-Time: 		Immediate Start
Reports to:		Facility Manager
Job Title: 		Registered Nurse (Aged Care)
Salary range: 	$82,000 - $90,000 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About the Role
Our client is looking for an experienced and compassionate Registered Nurse to join their dedicated aged care team. In this role, you will help residents live with dignity, independence and wellbeing, while working in a supportive and respectful community environment. You will be responsible for delivering safe and high-quality clinical care, managing medications, monitoring health conditions and providing hands-on nursing support tailored to each resident’s individual needs. Your commitment to person-centred care will ensure that every resident receives the best possible support to maintain their health, comfort and quality of life. If this seems like a good fit, please read below!

Key Responsibilities
• Provide high-quality, person-centred nursing care to elderly residents, especially those with complex and changing health conditions.
• Deliver clinical care such as medication administration, wound care, chronic disease management and palliative care, in line with best practice.
• Assist residents and their families to make informed decisions about their care, ensuring their wishes and preferences are respected.
• Respond promptly and professionally to any changes in residents’ conditions and to clinical emergencies.
• Work closely with residents, families, and the multidisciplinary care team to assess care needs and develop individualised aged care plans.
• Review and update care plans regularly to reflect changing health status and personal goals.
• Ensure all nursing activities, progress notes and observations are clearly and accurately documented according to policy and legislative requirements.
• Supervise and mentor Enrolled Nurses, Personal Care Workers and other support staff to ensure safe, effective, and compassionate care delivery.
• Provide clear clinical direction and guidance, fostering a positive and collaborative team environment.
• Support staff to develop their knowledge and skills in aged care best practice.
• Maintain a safe, supportive and homelike environment that promotes residents’ health, comfort, security and quality of life.
• Uphold residents’ privacy, dignity, cultural identity and individual choices always.
• Comply with all relevant aged care standards, policies and procedures to ensure the highest levels of care quality and safety.
• Participate in continuous quality improvement initiatives to enhance the resident experience.
• Take part in ongoing training and professional development to keep up to date with aged care best practices, policies and regulatory requirements.
• Actively contribute to a positive workplace culture focused on learning, respect and excellence in care.

Skills & Experience
• Current registration with AHPRA as a Registered Nurse.
• Minimum 1 year of practical nursing experience, ideally in residential or community aged care.
• NDIS Worker Screening Check (current or dated within five years).
• Fully vaccinated for influenza (annually) and COVID-19.
• Demonstrated understanding of the Aged Care Quality Standards and person-centred care principles.
• Strong teamwork and leadership skills, with excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
• Own reliable transport.
• Commitment to long-term employment in a caring, community-focused aged care setting.

Apply Now:
If you have a genuine passion for aged care and want to be part of a dedicated team making a positive impact in your community, we’d love to hear from you.

result.description:
Implementation & Activation Manager
WPP AUNZ–Barangaroo NSW
This is a role at WPP Media which is part of the WPP network
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $90,000 - $92,000 inclusive of superannuation
Location: Office location will be determined dependent on the right applicant, as we have offices based in Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth and Brisbane

About WPP Media

WPP Media is the leading global media investment management company serving as the parent to WPP media agencies including Mindshare, EssenceMediacom, Wavemaker, Choreograph and GOAT. With 1,000+ people based across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth, WPP Media’s primary purpose is to maximize performance of WPP’s agencies by operating as leader and collaborator in trading, content creation, sports, digital, finance, proprietary tool development and other business-critical capabilities. WPP Media’s focus is to deliver unrivalled advantage to its clients, stakeholders, and people. Combined with WPP Media’s global scale, our media investment decisions—guided by brand safety, leading privacy principles and premium relationships— represent 1 out of 3 ads in the global marketplace. Through modern investment services, we put money against goals that move businesses forward.

Implementation & Activation

The Implementation & Activation team is responsible for delivering best-in-class media planning and buying for our award-winning agency brands. 

The scope of the Implementation & Activation team covers all media channels and touchpoints, with a focus on delivering omnichannel media plans in each of our client patches and brands. Sitting centrally alongside our Implementation & Activation team is our Centre of Excellence, housing the Media Operations team and Craft Heads. 

With our collective industry expertise, we navigate the ever-changing media landscape efficiently and effectively, fuelling growth for the brands we work with. Our commitment to transparency and accountability drives best-in-class results consistently, leveraging our exceptional media relationships to keep our finger on the pulse of emerging opportunities.

Role Outline

The Implementation & Activation Manager is an important role, ensuring operational excellence and responsible for driving day-to-day work that delivers effective campaigns, ensuring best-in-class consistent implementation, optimisation, and reporting. Working very closely with your Director, you will produce best-in-class solutions, offer unparalleled service and deliver against targets.

The role involves the development and application of specialist technical skills, as well as solid people management.

Key Responsibilities

CLIENTS

Help build on the agency's reputation for outstanding client service. 
Clear understanding of the in-scope services of your clients and the process for completing work above and beyond.
Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with clients at an intermediate level, as it relates to implementation planning & activation. 
Proactively recommend tactics and opportunities that resolve client challenges and objectives.

PRODUCT

Bring innovation and creativity to the table, leveraging insights from across the market
Engage with internal WPP Media teams to ensure you have an understanding about their offerings and relevance to our clients.
Confident in your knowledge of media planning principles (e.g., scheduling, flighting, recency, effective reach theories, seasonality, market prioritisation, roles of all communication channels) and strong ability to utilise proprietary and industry tools to enhance and support planned recommendation.
Ownership of the media plan, including reconciliation, and the update of plan changes, with detailed updates for internal stakeholders.
Able to construct and present robust Implementation plans, that are grounded in strategic priorities. 
Oversee the construct and presentation of insightful and progressive post analysis reports.
Responsible for ensuring all financial and compliance processes are followed with 100% accuracy, including bookings and loadings
Seek to find, communicate, and implement improvements in all aspects of the role. 
When required, a strict adherence to activation commitments that have client contract association.

PEOPLE
Provide clear guidance and instruction when teaching & helping others.
Contribute to great teamwork with a supportive and positive attitude.
Oversee workflow of direct reports, swiftly escalating issues as they arise.
Motivate and empower direct reports to achieve individual, team and org goals. 
Conduct fortnightly 1:1s, annual Career Conversations and Performance Reviews with direct reports.
Liaise with the People Team to resolve any team disputes to ensure a safe and productive team environment. 
Continuously champion company values to build strong and trusted connections, solution-oriented perspectives and demonstrate that you genuinely care for collective team success. 

GROWTH & MARKETING
Collaborate closely with your manager to identify, collate and showcase examples of great work from within the team, both internally and externally.
Be a positive face of the agency at industry events, either related to clients’ category or our media partners.

REQUIRED CAPABILITIES
You feel empowered to bring your authentic self to work, and contribute to great teamwork, knowing your individual ideas and thoughts will be welcome.
Keen interest in our industry and excited to work with market leading partners & technologies.
Inquisitive and demonstrates desire to understand and know more. 
Ability to prioritise tasks effectively, ensuring that the most important and urgent ones are identified and addressed first. 
Results driven with the ability to identify and clearly articulate what’s working and why. 
Problem solving mentality. Attention to detail. Clear communicator.
result.title: Implementation & Activation Manager

Location: 		Port Broughton, SA, 5522
Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Reports to:		Aged Care Facility Manager
Job Title: 		Enrolled Nurse
Salary range: 	$79,500 - $85,000 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role
Our client is a highly respected aged care provider in the Port Broughton region, known for person-centred care and modern, homelike facilities. We are seeking a full-time Enrolled Nurse to join their dedicated team. This role offers long-term stability in a well-resourced facility that values staff. You will provide hands-on clinical and personal care, foster meaningful resident connections, and work within a collaborative team. The position includes ongoing training and professional development to support your growth in the aged care sector.

Key Responsibilities
• Assist in assessing, planning, and implementing resident care under RN supervision.
• Administer medications and treatments per facility protocols.
• Monitor and document health status, reporting changes to the RN.
• Perform wound care, catheter management, and other clinical interventions.
• Support residents with ADLs (bathing, dressing, mobility, feeding).
• Uphold person-centred care respecting dignity and preferences.
• Engage residents in social activities to enhance wellbeing.
• Provide emotional support to residents and families.
• Adhere to infection control, WHS, and aged care quality standards.
• Maintain accurate documentation in care records.
• Follow facility policies and regulatory requirements.
• Work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
• Participate in handovers, meetings, and training.
• Mentor less experienced care staff as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements
Essential:
• Diploma of Nursing with current AHPRA registration as an EN.
• Minimum 1 year aged care/dementia care experience (preferred).
• Strong clinical skills in medication administration and chronic disease management.
• Knowledge of Aged Care Quality Standards and person-centred care.
• Current First Aid & CPR certification.
• National Police Check and NDIS Worker Screening.
• Annual flu vaccination and full COVID-19 immunisation compliance.

Desirable:
• Palliative care and complex health needs experience.
• Knowledge of electronic health records (e.g., iCare, MHR).
• Thrives in a team environment and seeks long-term employment.
Personal Attributes:
• Compassionate, patient, and empathetic.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Resilient and able to work in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits
• Competitive hourly rates + penalty rates (if applicable).
• Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
• Supportive and collaborative team environment.
